title: What the Collective Has at Stake in Late Equipment Rental and Demo Kit
content:
The size of the security hold standing against an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement is the measure of what the collective has at stake in the kit that has not come back, and the daily figure the overdue days are charged at is raised where that stake is large.

## The rule

Where the security hold standing against the agreement is at or above 500.00 USD, the daily figure is raised by the high exposure uplift. The high exposure uplift is 20 per cent.

Where the security hold standing against the agreement is below 500.00 USD but at or above 200.00 USD, the daily figure is raised by the moderate exposure uplift instead. The moderate exposure uplift is 10 per cent.

In any other case the daily figure carries no uplift under this heading.

## The bands and their edges

| Security hold standing against the agreement | Uplift on the daily figure |
| --- | --- |
| 500.00 USD or more | 20 per cent |
| 200.00 USD or more but below 500.00 USD | 10 per cent |
| below 200.00 USD | none under this heading |

Both edges are read inclusively from below: a hold standing at exactly 500.00 USD sits in the first band, and a hold standing at exactly 200.00 USD sits in the second. A hold of 199.99 USD sits outside both.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical agreement

Take an agreement whose daily figure stands at 28.00 USD when this heading is reached.

- The hold standing against it is 650.00 USD: the daily figure is raised by 20 per cent, which gives 33.60 USD.
- The hold standing against it is 250.00 USD: the daily figure is raised by 10 per cent, which gives 30.80 USD.
- The hold standing against it is 100.00 USD: the daily figure carries no uplift under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**What is weighed.** What is weighed is the hold still standing against that agreement, being what was placed against it less what has already gone back, and not the figure the package carries on the schedule.
